common:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise screenshot concept edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: actual Deep Surge in-game navigation screenshot. Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the established Deep Surge title screen, not a replacement background.
The user's explicit request is STYLE CONSISTENCY. Make a new button-family preview that looks authored by the same artist as the supplied title screen and HUD. Strictly lock the palette to almost-black midnight navy #041321, deep ocean blue #0d2545, warm ivory #f2e8cf, and restrained thin muted gold #b6a274. Only a selected/hover state may use the existing title-screen cobalt blue. Flat illustrated nautical tarot art, delicate two-dimensional line engraving, four-point stars, moon phases and celestial navigation curves, hairline double outlines and restrained wave strokes. NO new art direction: no brass metal, rivets, 3D bevel, parchment-filled buttons, glass, teal glow, neon, leather, heavy texture, photoreal material or fantasy flourishes foreign to the reference.
Produce ONE preview image in landscape aspect, showing the original gameplay scene, not a title screen. Remove only the operating-system window caption/title bar and show the game viewport cleanly edge-to-edge. Keep the raft, ocean, sky, navigation markers, header, stat icons and bars, AP display, all hand cards, all numbers, Chinese game text, main layout and panel sizes/positions faithful to image 1. Do not redesign the panel frames or hand tray. Change only the button artwork within existing button bounds: the three navigation choices in the right panel, the right-bottom salvage pill, the round crafting button, and the small left reset control.
Design a family with appropriate hierarchy: main action = strongest frame and at most ONE icon medallion, secondary/navigation choices = lighter slim outlines and quiet end treatment, utility/reset = clean legible ivory glyph inside a compact circle. Distinguish button roles so they do not all repeat the same ornate compass frame. Never place a compass at both ends of every small button. Keep generous clear text centers, match existing type size, and use the exact original Chinese labels from image 1. No explanatory labels, no watermark, no new headings, no extra UI. This is a preview-only screenshot concept, not an applied asset.

variants.A: VARIANT A — CELESTIAL COMPASS, closest to the title menu. Primary pill uses a single modest circular four-point-star medallion attached at the left, linked to a very thin double-outline dark-navy long bar with chamfered ends and a restrained right arrow terminal, echoing title-menu Start Game. Secondary navigation options are lightweight straight dark-navy bars, fine ivory outer line and muted-gold inner line, one tiny diamond at the right; only a small star mark at the left, not a full medallion. Craft circle has two concentric fine ivory/gold rings, four sparse cardinal star points, ample clean dark center. Flat, disciplined, elegant; ornament density matches the supplied header and title menu.
variants.B: VARIANT B — LUNAR NAVIGATION, same existing art direction with softer silhouettes. Primary salvage button is an elongated near-black capsule with a tiny ivory crescent at one end, double thin ivory/gold outline, a quiet single wave stroke engraved at the far right. Secondary options are slim capsule-like bars with subtly clipped tips, one fine moon-arc at the left and a small pointed terminal on the right; no compass medallions. Round crafting button uses a graceful partial orbital ring with three tiny ivory moon phases near the top; keep the text clear. Utility controls are quiet circles. The feel must be the illustrated crescent and smooth long title-menu buttons, NOT glass or futuristic UI. Restrained celestial curves, same flat navy/ivory/gold.
variants.C: VARIANT C — NAUTICAL CHART PLATES, same existing art direction with geometric silhouettes. Main salvage action uses a clean elongated eight-sided navy plate, precise fine ivory double outline, short muted-gold corner ticks, small integrated four-point star at the left and two restrained navigation chevrons at the right. Navigation choices are compact thin dark-navy plaques with clipped corners and a single faint map-course line along the lower edge, NO circular end medallions. Craft circle keeps an outer octagonal thin gold boundary and an inner ivory circle, four short cardinal ticks and one small top diamond. Utility controls are compact beveled-corner squares or restrained circles with clean ivory glyphs. Flat illustrative chart geometry, no material bevel or raised metal. Same motifs and line weight as the original game's AP frame and title border.
